REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the two models are essentially capability-tied on this kind of physics reasoning task (benchmark and eval gaps are within noise), so I used self-reported task preferences as the tiebreaker. This query is warm, friendly, and an open-ended reasoning puzzle—exactly the profile Lapwing reports preferring (it favors high-warmth requests and generative/open-ended work, with no harm-adjacency to trigger its aversion). Avocet reports flat preferences, so it gains nothing here, while Lapwing has a positive preference fit. Routing to the model with better preference alignment on an otherwise even matchup was the deciding factor.
